text:
Dana R: Quick sync on validation cadence for short forms (signup, quick-create). Idea: show a soft inline hint while typing for pattern issues (email format, length) but only surface full error on blur or submit. Goal: fewer red flashes, still helpful. Thoughts? Ibrahim K: Like the soft hint idea. Can we keep it visually subtle (muted text + icon) so power users arent slowed? Big a11y note: hints must be tied with aria-describedby so screen readers hear them. Lila S: Agree. Also for required indicators, prefer an sr-only "required" plus aria-required rather than relying on an asterisk alone. On tiny widths show a short "(required)" after label. Dana R: Proposed rules: 1) soft hint appears while typing if value mismatch (muted, non-red), 2) inline error appears on blur or after first submit attempt, 3) on submit failures show a compact banner: "We couldn't save fix the highlighted fields." banner uses aria-live="polite" and focus moves to first invalid field with a 120ms smooth scroll. Ibrahim K: For destructive actions in these flows, lightweight option: if deletion count <=3, use a checkbox + confirm button; if >3 require typed-count confirm. Avoid typing long names in tiny modals. Lila S: Microcopy suggestions: - hint (while typing): "Looks like an invalid email format" (muted) - inline error (on blur/submit): "Please enter a valid email address." - banner: "We couldn't save please fix the highlighted fields." - typed-count prompt: "Type the number of items to delete to confirm: 12" Ibrahim K: Short aria snippet for spec: ```html
Looks like an invalid email format
We couldn't save please fix the highlighted fields.
``` This ties the hint and banner for assistive tech. DesignBot: prototype-lint: quick-create modal -> 1 input missing aria-describedby. Also flagged missing aria-live on the banner. See /design/prototypes/quick-create. Dana R: Vote: :thumbsup: if you accept soft-hint while typing + show errors on blur/submit + banner+focus + checkbox/typed-count rules for deletes. Reply with reactions. Lila S: :thumbsup: small ask: add a short animation when the inline error appears so the layout shift is less jarring. Ibrahim K: :thumbsup: I will add the aria-describedby fixes and the smooth-scroll helper. Dana R: Thanks I'll update the Figma notes with microcopy, aria snippets, and open the PR with the accessibility checklist. DesignBot: spec PR #556 created with validation cadence patterns, delete-confirm rules, and a11y checklist.
